sloka: द्विष्त्पक्ष्ह्मविज्ञाय नीतिबाह्यास्त्वबुद्धयः ।राजन् परिघ शक्ति ऋष्टि शूल पट्टस सम्कुलम् ॥६-७-२॥।।
transliteration: dviṣtpakṣhmavijñāya nītibāhyāstvabuddhayaḥ ।rājan parigha śakti ṛṣṭi śūla paṭṭasa samkulam ॥6-7-2॥।।

translations.english: "O King The ogres are not having political intelligence. They have submitted themselves, even though they are mighty and are having iron bars, javelins, sharp edged spears, and doubleedged swords."
translations.hindi: महाराज; जब तक शत्रु का बलाबल न मालूस हो, तब तक परामर्श देना नीति-विरुद्ध और निवुद्धियों का काम दै
